items.goal: extend the dreamer in `src/cerebellum/dreamer.ts` with a curiosity-mode alongside the current dream mode. Curiosity-mode reads self-model.md aspirations and generates 'explore X' / 'try Y' style backlog items that are NOT fixes to existing problems — they are capability expansions. Add new origin 'curiosity' to BacklogOrigin in `src/orchestrator/events.ts` and route curiosity-seeded items to pending-review like dreams. This closes the 'all goals are borrowed' gap by giving the agent a third goal source beyond user and dream.
